name: @thednp/rpc
author: thednp
description: ⚡ A Vite plugin for creating server functions with automatic Remote Procedure Calls (RPC)

tasks.clean: rm -rf examples/**/dist examples/**/node_modules examples/**/package-lock.json examples/**/pnpm-lock.yaml examples/**/bun.lockb examples/**/deno.lock
tasks.dev: cd examples/spa && deno update && deno task dev
tasks.dev:koa: cd examples/koa && deno update && deno task dev
tasks.dev:express: cd examples/express && deno update && deno task dev
tasks.dev:fastify: cd examples/fastify && deno update && deno task dev
tasks.dev:hono: cd examples/hono && deno update && deno task dev
tasks.dev:ssr: cd examples/ssr && deno update && deno task dev
tasks.lint: deno task lint:ts && deno task check:ts
tasks.upd: deno task up:examples && deno task up:root && deno task up:deno
tasks.prepublishOnly: deno task upd && deno task lint && pnpm ci && deno task format && deno task audit:src && deno task build
